detail.longDescription: "Treat documentation as part of the product and your organizational health - This one is evergreen. If you ship a product and it isn't documented, you don't care about docs. - Treat internal docs the same way. If you don't care about internal docs, you don't care about your organization. - Jeff Bezos treated communication as a defect: if people have to talk to each other, your interfaces aren't designed and documented well enough. Teams should communicate through well-documented APIs, not meetings. It's the introvert's manifesto. Document your stuff and we can socialize over lunch, but I don't want to stop what I'm doing to explain how an endpoint works. - Your team should be an interface to the rest of the company. Document your operating model, your tools, and how to connect to your internal services or infrastructure. - Agents can now do more human-like work, so they also want your working hours, communication preferences, and roles and responsibilities. Don't schedule a meeting for something that could be written down." https:// davenunez.com/writing/document ation-for-humans-and-agents # TechnicalWriting # SoftwareDocumentation # Documentation # DocsAsProduct # AI # AIAgents
